$comment: Generated from the Factory file parser and the catalogues its apply path validates against. Edit logic/factoryfile/schema, then regenerate; a hand edit is reverted by the drift test.
title: automations/<name>/automation.md frontmatter (v1alpha1)
description: YAML frontmatter of an Automation file. The Automation's name comes from its directory, never from a field. The Markdown body after the closing fence is the run prompt.

displayName.description: Optional display label. Null clears it; the Automation's identity and canonical name still come from its directory.

worker.description: Name of a declared worker. Defaults to the MAIN/FOREMAN worker when omitted. Not valid together with stage.

agent.description: Deprecated alias of worker. Set only one of the two.

required_repos.description: Repositories, attached to the same Factory, that must be eagerly prepared for every run this Automation triggers, in addition to its Agent's own required_repos.

stage.description: Name of the blueprint stage that receives the event. Requires a blueprint; not valid with worker or any per-run override.

stringMatcher.description: A bare array is sugar for {in: [...]}. Within a field, in matches ANY-of and not_in excludes ANY-of. Null and an empty matcher impose nothing.

stringMatcherInOnly.description: A bare array is sugar for {in: [...]}. This field supports only in: an exclusion would match everything else in scope.

webhookIDsMatcher.description: Exactly one webhook source UID, as an in-only matcher or its bare-array shorthand.

intMatcher.description: A bare array is sugar for {in: [...]}. Within a field, in matches ANY-of and not_in excludes ANY-of. Null and an empty matcher impose nothing.

intMatcherInOnly.description: A bare array is sugar for {in: [...]}. This field supports only in: an exclusion would match everything else in scope.

stringAliasList.description: A provider alias takes a bare list of names, never a matcher object, because its values are resolved against the provider before the filter is canonicalized.

intAliasList.description: A provider alias takes a bare list of positive numbers, never a matcher object, because its values are resolved against the provider before the filter is canonicalized.

payloadPattern.description: Structural pattern over the delivery body. Keys mirror the payload and AND together; an absent key imposes nothing.

payloadPatternValue.description: A bare array is sugar for {in: [...]}. An operator object takes in, not_in, contains, and exists; any other object nests further into the payload. contains matches a string holding ANY of its keywords as a case-sensitive substring.

botPolicy.description: Which bot-authored events to skip: all bots, only Warp-owned bots (self), or none.

jql.description: Optional Jira issue query. Trimmed before validation; must contain 1–10000 characters and cannot accompany Basic issue predicates. Event predicates remain active.

inlineSchedule.description: A cron schedule declared inline on a schedule.cron_fired trigger. Only valid on that kind.

name.description: Stable identity of this declaration within the Automation. At most one inline schedule may omit name. Changing name replaces the schedule; changing only cron updates it in place.

cron.description: Standard five-field cron expression or a descriptor (@daily, @hourly, @every 1h). Always interpreted in UTC: a CRON_TZ= or TZ= prefix and the six-field seconds form are both rejected. The pattern is structural; the parser is the authority on the grammar.

event.description: Canonical event kind. The accepted values depend on the provider.

filter.description: Filter fields combine with AND. An absent field is a wildcard. The accepted keys depend on the (provider, event) pair.
